title: Stewardess College 1968
description: Restored 1968 archival footage from American Airlines Stewardess College, the Fort Worth training world Robyn Stewart entered in 1971.
body: Robyn's training world: weight checks, girdle rules, the machine that made cabin crews. Shown through restored college footage from 1968.
